title: A polar-factor retraction on the symplectic Stiefel manifold with closed-form inverse
summary: In Riemannian computing applications, it is crucial to map manifold data to a Euclidean domain, where vector space arithmetic is available, and back. Classical manifold theory guarantees the existence of such mappings, called charts and parameterizations, or, collectively, local coordinates. When computational efficiency is of the essence, practitioners usually resort to retraction maps to define local coordinates.
